title: Multisig wallets that call `StargateLbpHelper.participate()` could cause received token to be stolen
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as received tokens on destination chain will be lost  **Likelihood:** Medium, this occurs when caller is a multisig wallet contract  ## Description  `StargateLbpHelper.participate()` is used to perform a cross chain transfer to the host chain and then a swap using the Balancer Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool.  The issue is that the receiver address of the LBP swap on the destination chain is hardcoded to `msg.sender` (passed in by `participate()`).
